commands.text: Local rows run in minutes on a developer machine; hosted rows run only on the pushed head. Minutes are estimates from the job shape and timeout-minutes. A "red run" is a failed GitHub Actions run of that job, the evidence that the command can fail; where none exists in the last eighty failed runs the commit owner shows the focused product RED instead.

Acceptance lines of pull request 2, each bound to existing rows:

The candidate gate keeps its budget of 40 minutes: the focused off-chain suite narrowed to the receipt rows and the command-run specs, the conformance unit suite, the off-chain lint, the off-chain component build, the conformance format and lint checks, the application separation check, and the rendered documentation check on a documentation candidate; the open-datum tests with the open-datum build and lint on a candidate that edits the open-datum package. The journey script is exercised only by the Demo 1 jobs: the run that edits it may run the Demo 1 command-line check once locally, in a box of its own, the gate run time, named apart from the writer minutes; a failure of that one run is one repair, never a campaign. Each run takes its temporary folders from its own fresh directory under the lane scratch folder, removed when the run ends. The full repository gate runs once on the final candidate.
